description: Append-only Dead-End & Architectural Decision Ledger so new agent sessions do not re-litigate solved traps without new evidence (e.g., an upstream API/OS release, policy change, or hardware upgrade).
revisit_policy: Do not re-attempt a recorded DEAD_END unless new evidence is logged in `revisit_trigger_evidence`.

dead_ends.failed_approach: Service Account JSON keys (`constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`) or Workspace-Internal OAuth client (`RAPT` 9-hour re-auth expiry).
dead_ends.working_resolution: Zero-Key Direct Google Account OAuth 2.0 (`External` Desktop OAuth client + `constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains = ALLOW` on `projects/{{PUBSUB_PROJECT_ID}}`).
dead_ends.revisit_when_new_evidence: Only if Google Workspace introduces non-expiring workload identity federation for consumer peer accounts.

dead_ends.failed_approach: Granting a bot/concierge account (`<bot-handle>`) writer ACLs on Google's auto-generated `family-<id>` group calendar (`HTTP 400 Bad Request`).
dead_ends.working_resolution: Create a dedicated standard shared `'Family'` Google Calendar owned by a parent and share `writer` ACLs with the family members and concierge bot.
dead_ends.revisit_when_new_evidence: Only if Google Calendar API v3 lifts ACL restrictions on `group.calendar.google.com` family calendars.

dead_ends.failed_approach: Assuming a device is healthy because its IP/MAC responds to ping or shows `CONNECTED` at Layer 3.
dead_ends.working_resolution: Verify cross-layer relational bindings (`SLO-4`: e.g., doorbell `ringSettings` includes the chime ID AND chime state is `CONNECTED`).
dead_ends.revisit_when_new_evidence: Always keep relational probes alongside component probes.
